title: 埃默里大学专家：不必波动，但需关注公共卫生基础设施
speaker: Dr. Carlos Del Rio

segments.en: I think about this one, I would not be worried. I agree with Dr. Tedros. I think there's still a lot of trauma left from COVID.
segments.zh: 对于这次疫情，我不担心。我同意谭德塞博士的看法，新冠疫情留下的创伤仍然很多。

segments.en: But I would say don't be worried. But this is not the first outbreak. This is not the last outbreak. What I we worried about is that we will continue to see this kind of outbreaks.
segments.zh: 但我想说，不必担心。这不是第一次疫情，也不是最后一次。我担心的是我们会继续看到这类疫情。

segments.en: We are continuing to have outbreaks like this one. Believe me, a hint of ours in a cruise ship was not in my bigger card of things that was going to happen in a cruise ship. And yet it happened.
segments.zh: 我们不断遇到这样的疫情。相信我，游轮上的汉坦病毒并不在我预料之中，但它确实发生了。

segments.en: So we're going to see more things like this one. And what people in the US need to be worried about is our public health infrastructure. They need to be worried about we can see the CDC has been significantly diminished and in relevance. And a lot of people have left all the expertise have left CDC.
segments.zh: 因此，我们还会看到更多类似事件。美国人需要担心的是我们的公共卫生基础设施。我们看到疾控中心的重要性已大幅下降，许多专家已经离开。

segments.en: So I would say that what we need to ask for and what we need to be worried about is the state or public health and global health expertise in our country, rather than this is specific outbreak.
segments.zh: 所以我认为，我们需要关注和担忧的是我们国家的公共卫生和全球健康专业能力，而不是这次具体的疫情。
